scenes.title: The Manner of Imitation
scenes.summary: One may imitate by narrating, as Homer does, now becoming another and now speaking as oneself, or by presenting all the characters acting.

scenes.title: Sophocles Between Homer and Aristophanes
scenes.summary: Sophocles is like Homer in imitating serious people and like Aristophanes in imitating people acting; hence, some say, the name drama.

scenes.title: The Dorian Claim
scenes.summary: The Dorians claim tragedy and comedy: the Megarians at home and in Sicily, home of Epicharmus, claim comedy, some Peloponnesians tragedy, arguing from the words kōmai, "villages", and dran, "to do".
